text:
lee: starting a quick infra apply to patch routing for release/2026-canary in ~5m. tasks: net module patch, backend state refresh. quick heads-up — provider pin check too.

tanya: ack. i'll watch remote state and lock. remind me if TF backend lock occurs; i can handle unlocks.

infra-bot: preflight: checking provider constraints. found env override: `provider \"aws\" { version = \">= 4.1, < 5.0\" }`. recommendation: pin to `~> 4.2.1` to avoid minor bump drift during canary.

lee: thanks. we'll pin locally in the workspace before apply.

deploy-bot: running `terraform plan -target=module.net.route_fix -refresh=true -var-file=canary.tfvars`

deploy-bot: ERROR: remote state lock detected (lock id: b2d9-...): last held by user:tanya at 2026-06-15T09:12:30Z

tanya: that's me — i left a hanging lock from earlier drift investigation. i'm unlocking now.

tanya: command i ran:```
terraform force-unlock b2d9-9f1b-4a2c -state=gs://redwood-terraform-state/infra.tfstate
```

deploy-bot: lock cleared. re-running plan.

deploy-bot: plan OK. predicted changes: update route propagation on module.net (2 resources to change). no IAM changes.

lee: apply queued. command:```
terraform apply -target=module.net.route_fix -auto-approve -var-file=canary.tfvars
```

deploy-bot: apply started. streaming logs: `apply: 2/2 resources updated`

deploy-bot: apply complete. routes patched, propagated to canary vpc. health-checks show green.

release-manager: canary looks healthy. moving traffic 10% -> canary. adding note to release docs: "network routing patch applied; provider pin validated. backend lock required manual unlock by oncall."

lee: added provider pin to workspace via `terraform init -upgrade=false` and updated modules with `provider \"aws\" { version = \"~> 4.2.1\" }` in infra root. will open a PR to make pin permanent for all envs.

ops-oncall: noted. created a short runbook step: if backend lock persists after 15m, contact tanya or run force-unlock and annotate ticket. also added a PagerDuty override for the canary ramp.

infra-bot: follow-up reminder: schedule IAM or trust changes only during the maintenance window. any future role trust updates should be separated from routing applies.

lee: thanks all. closing this thread; PR incoming for provider pin and a short postmortem on the stray lock. :thumbsup:
